item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Two tests I would like to see:

Breaking the speed of light, and shadow pathfinding. The first is simple; can the prisoner move faster than light? How much energy can be used to move a prisoner? Maybe the heavily redacted sunrise test answered this question?

The second test asks how the nail chooses a route to reestablish shadow contact. Does it choose the shortest route, or the most direct route? If it chooses the shortest route, how well does its algorithm work? Can it be confused? Does it have perfect knowledge of the shadowscape it inhabits?

Inconsistencies might suggest the presence of an intelligence residing in the nail, or otherwise associated with the nail. Further tests could then interrogate the nature of this intelligence.

This is one of the carved pieces of ochre recovered from Blombos Cave in South Africa. The artifacts are estimated to be ~77,000 years old. item.title: Crosstest/tale idea
item.content:encoded:
1. Expose someone to SCP-1008.
  2. Wait until they're about two to three weeks in, just to make sure it's in full force.
  3. Put them in an open field, where nothing but the sun can give them a shadow.
  4. Drop SCP-272 into their shadow.
  5. See what happens. Does whoever 272 answers to recognize 1008's authority to take away the sun? Does something more interesting happen? I want to read it! :-o

Anyways, I love this SCP, and I want to see more articles with thorough testing logs like this one.

From a cave near the discovery site, translated from [REDACTED]:

I am a simple iron nail
Born of earth and fire
Crafted by hands not of man
A punishment for the younger fool
Who drank from my oasis and ate my fruit
As punishment, you are bound to this spot
Oasis and fruit trees cast 99 leagues afar
Just beyond your reach, to the west and to the east
You are the fool who ate from the demons land
But blame me not
For I am a simple iron nail
